metadata.title: Intrinsic mirror symmetry for orbifold cubic surfaces and the $A_1$ spherical DAHA
metadata.abstract: We determine the intrinsic mirror of an orbifold cubic surface with three nodes and interpret the resulting geometry through mirror symmetry between the $PGL(2,\mathbb{C})$ and $SL(2,\mathbb{C})$ character varieties of the once-punctured torus. We further construct a quantization of the mirror using higher genus Gromov-Witten theory and show that it recovers the $A_1$ spherical double affine Hecke algebra.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 轨形三次曲面的镜像与球形 DAHA
analysis.workSummary: 确定三节点轨形三次曲面的内蕴镜像，联系一次穿孔环面 PGL(2,C) 与 SL(2,C) 特征簇，并借高亏格 Gromov–Witten 理论量子化镜像，得到 A₁ 球形双仿射 Hecke 代数。
analysis.breakthrough: 将具体镜像几何与球形 DAHA 的代数结构相连。
analysis.limitations: 结果针对所述轨形三次曲面与 A₁ 型代数。
